info.title: SCOPE API
info.summary: AI-Assisted Smoking Violation Reporting and Monitoring System
info.description: Photographic evidence is classified **before** submission, so no unvalidated report ever reaches the database. Administrators hold read-only access: there is no endpoint anywhere in this API that verifies, approves, rejects or amends a filed report.

get.description:
Reports filed from this handset, newest first.

A receipt log, not a tracker — no status is returned, because nothing in
the system can change a report after it is filed. History is bound to the
device identifier and does not survive a reinstall; the app states this
plainly rather than letting a user read it as a bug.

schema.title: Response Report History Api V1 Reports Device  Device Id  Get

get.description:
Detail of one report.

``device_id`` is required and must match the filing device. Without it, a
guessed reference number would expose someone else's photographic evidence.

schema.title: Response List Infographics Api V1 Infographics Get

get.description:
Aggregated report density.

Returns rounded coordinates with weights, never individual reports. The
public map shows where violations concentrate; it never attributes a report
to a named premise. That is a deliberate decision protecting both reporter
safety and the system's defamation exposure, and it is why this endpoint
exposes no reference number, premise name or timestamp.

Officers get full precision on D03 instead — precision for enforcement,
privacy for everyone else.

schema.title: Response Hotspots Api V1 Hotspots Get
Response Search Places Api V1 Geo Search Get

get.summary: Resolve a search result to coordinates (S11)
get.description:
Turn an autocomplete suggestion into a taggable point.

Autocomplete returns place identifiers, not coordinates, so selecting a
search result needs this second call before the map pin can move.

Resolve coordinates to an address and a suggested premise name.

The premise name is only a suggestion — S11 pre-fills the field with it and
the reporter may edit or clear it. It is free text, not a category, and is
never used for aggregation.

Export the filtered set for patrol planning.

The export is logged with its filter criteria. This data leaves the system,
so recording which officer took it and what they took is the PDPA Security
Principle expectation.

Report clusters at full officer-facing precision.

Note the deliberate difference from the public heatmap at /api/v1/hotspots:
administrators get clusters resolvable to a location, the public gets
density with no individual pins. Precision for enforcement, privacy for
everyone else.

location_integrity_metres.title: Location Integrity Metres
location_integrity_metres.description: Distance between capture position and tagged position. A large divergence is worth an officer's attention.

AdminReportRow.title: AdminReportRow
AdminReportRow.description: A D04 table row. Five columns, no status, no premise type.

ClassificationOut.title: ClassificationOut
ClassificationOut.description: D05 AI panel. Display only — provenance, not a control.

validation_token.title: Validation Token
validation_token.description: Opaque handle to the server's record of this classification. Present it to POST /reports; it is single-use.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: PASS when at least one photo cleared the threshold.

ClusterOut.title: ClusterOut
ClusterOut.description:
A D03 cluster, resolvable to a location — unlike the public heatmap.

``band`` indexes the four-step scale in section 10.4, which encodes count
three ways at once (size, colour, numeral) so the map survives colour-blind
viewing and black-and-white printing.

HotspotPoint.title: HotspotPoint
HotspotPoint.description:
One weighted point of the public density heatmap.

Coordinates are ROUNDED before they leave the server. The public map shows
where violations concentrate, never which premise was reported — that
distinction protects both reporter safety and the system's defamation
exposure. Full precision is available only to authenticated officers on D03.

OverviewResponse.title: OverviewResponse
OverviewResponse.description:
D02 panels.

Deliberately absent: average AI confidence, pending-review count, verified
count. All three described a verification workflow that no longer exists.

PlaceDetail.title: PlaceDetail
PlaceDetail.description: A search result resolved to a taggable point (S11).

duplicate_submission.title: Duplicate Submission
duplicate_submission.description: True when this token had already been submitted; the original reference number is returned rather than a second report filed.

ReportHistoryItem.title: ReportHistoryItem
ReportHistoryItem.description:
One row of Report History.

Carries no status field. Because evidence is validated before submission
and administrators are read-only, nothing can change a report's state after
filing; a status would advertise a workflow that does not exist.
